channel.title: Cointelegraph.com News
channel.description: Trimmed fixture: titles, links, dates and excerpts of at most 280 characters.

item.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
item.description: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

item.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
item.description: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

item.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
item.description: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

item.title: ‘MoldyRoost’ ads can steal crypto wallet recovery phrases from iPhones
item.description: The campaign used at least 480 ad domains to target users in more than 47 countries and could infect a vulnerable iPhone with a single tap.
